name: Rate-Matched Random Benchmark
description: Complete reproduction archive for the manuscript "A Rate-Matched Random Benchmark for Event Prediction: Sixteen Structural-Break and Turning-Point Models in Agricultural Commodity Prices". Sixteen structural-break and turning-point models are run through one walk-forward protocol on eight agricultural commodities over 2019-2026, and each is then compared against a null: alarms fired at the model's own rate but placed at random over the same evaluation dates. Of 118 testable model-commodity-event cells, two beat their own null at the five per cent level where chance predicts about six, and neither survives correction for multiple testing; more than half score below their null on average. Contents: the daily price series and both event sets (data/), the R and Python model pipelines (R/, python/), the validation suite implementing the permutation benchmark, the price-based event definition and the bootstrap (python/05_validation_suite.py), every intermediate and final result table (output/), and the manuscript source, compiled PDF and figures (paper/). The price data are redistributable and are included, so every number in the paper can be reproduced from this archive with no external download. The validation suite fixes its random seed, so the permutation and bootstrap results reproduce exactly.
